_comment: The cases Simulation 2.5 runs: 'what cannot be measured yet'. This file is the only
place they are defined. sim25.py, sim25_grid.py and tools/build_sim25_web.py all read
it, so adding or removing a case is an edit here and nowhere else.
A case is one combination of the things we cannot measure on this network. Every case
is run against every growth site and size, so the count multiplies: each case is 355
SWMM runs, about 4 minutes nested or 20 minutes on the whole domain. Four nominal plus
eight sensitivities is 12 cases and about 2 h 20 m.
AFTER EDITING THIS FILE THE COMMITTED RESULTS NO LONGER MATCH IT. The grid must be
re-run and the page rebuilt, or the page will simply show the cases that still have a
weather      the nominal sweep, one case each, and the only levels the corridor runs use.
ii is P04, infiltration in L/s per 100 m of pipe.
sensitivity  at_ii names which weather levels get the variants; each variant overrides
one field of Case and carries the words appended to that case's label.
Fields: pf (flat|harmon), age (uniform|weighted), bfac, stage, hour.

weather.label: Dry
weather.note: Sewage only, no infiltration: a genuinely dry day.

weather.label: Design wet
weather.note: Infiltration at the level that just meets the utility's own design rating for these pipes.

weather.label: Severe
weather.note: 2.4 times the design envelope: a heavy wet period.
